use_case: Tenant screening recommendations: the property management platform's integrated screening service scores each rental application and returns accept, accept with conditions (higher deposit), or decline
vendor_or_model: Tenant screening provider integrated in the property management platform (vendor scoring model on consumer report, eviction, criminal record, and income data)
data_categories: Applicant identity data; consumer reports (credit, eviction, criminal records); income and employment; Social Security numbers
human_in_the_loop: Today the recommendation is used as the decision in practice. Required from 2026-10-31: a leasing coordinator reviews every decline or conditional approval against the written criteria, with individualized review of criminal and eviction records, before any notice
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(a)-(b) and (f); 24 CFR 100.500 (in force; HUD proposed removal 2026); Fla. Stat. 760.23; FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681b and 1681m(a); FCRA disposal rule 16 CFR 682.3; N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a)); N53-R01 Safeguards Rule for service provider oversight (314.4(f)) as a company choice

use_case: Buyer lead scoring: the CRM scores inbound buyer inquiries (A, B, C) and sets the order in which inside sales agents respond
vendor_or_model: CRM vendor lead scoring feature (vendor machine learning model configured by the company)
data_categories: Inquiry contact data; ZIP code; inquiry language; price range; mortgage pre-approval status; web activity
human_in_the_loop: Inside sales agents see the score and choose whom to call; every lead must get a same-day response by policy, which the scoring currently undermines
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(b) and (d); Fla. Stat. 760.23; N53-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (45(a))
status: In production; ZIP code and language inputs to be removed by 2026-11-30

use_case: General-purpose generative AI for listing descriptions and marketing drafts
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (under evaluation); public chatbots used informally today
data_categories: Property features and marketing copy; risk of client or tenant data being pasted
risk_tier: Low (High if client data is entered)
human_in_the_loop: Agent or marketing staff edits every draft and checks it for discriminatory statements before publication
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(c) (discriminatory advertising); N53-R01 (314.4(c)(1)(ii)) and POL-05 4.8 for client data; N53-R02 (45(a))
status: Public tools prohibited for client data (POL-05 4.8); enterprise tool with no-training terms under evaluation (P01 R-026)
